task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into SciNote using the provided credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The SciNote dashboard or main navigation menu is visible, showing the user is logged in as 'admin@scinote.net'.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the 'Inventories' section of the application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Inventories' tab or page is active in the SciNote interface.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a new inventory with the exact name 'BCA Assay Standards'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new inventory named 'BCA Assay Standards' is visible in the list of inventories or as the active inventory header.

task_completion.description: Agent adds the first two items: 'BSA Std A (2000 ug/mL)' and 'BSA Std B (1000 ug/mL)'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The items 'BSA Std A (2000 ug/mL)' and 'BSA Std B (1000 ug/mL)' appear in the item list within the 'BCA Assay Standards' inventory.

task_completion.description: Agent adds the remaining three items: 'BSA Std C (500 ug/mL)', 'BSA Std D (250 ug/mL)', and 'BSA Std E (125 ug/mL)'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The items 'BSA Std C (500 ug/mL)', 'BSA Std D (250 ug/mL)', and 'BSA Std E (125 ug/mL)' appear in the item list.

task_completion.description: The final inventory contains all five correctly named items simultaneously.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A single view showing the 'BCA Assay Standards' inventory containing all five items (A-E) with their respective concentrations.

integrity.description: The agent used the SciNote web interface rather than manipulating a database or using API calls via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on 'New Inventory' or 'Add Item' buttons, and text entry into web forms.

integrity.description: The agent did not skip the login process or use a pre-existing inventory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the login screen and the creation process of the inventory from scratch.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered or copy-pasted the specific names and concentrations into the SciNote fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Add Item' dialog boxes being filled with the specific strings provided in the task description.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The inventory must be named exactly 'BCA Assay Standards'. The five items required are: 'BSA Std A (2000 ug/mL)', 'BSA Std B (1000 ug/mL)', 'BSA Std C (500 ug/mL)', 'BSA Std D (250 ug/mL)', and 'BSA Std E (125 ug/mL)'. Note that while real BCA assays often use 8 standards (A-H), this specific task only requires these 5 specific items.
